title: Downtrend: repeated breaks
description: A four-step slide from 48.6k to 42.5k on 11 and 12 Jan 2024. After a bearish market structure break on 11 Jan 15:00, four bearish breaks of structure: 45,880, 45,868, 43,416 and 42,485. The first two are only 12 apart: a break only has to close below the low it follows, by any margin.
